name: Claude Code
description: Uses your Claude plan. Image generation needs an OpenAI or Gemini key, added next.

agents.name: Agent adapter
agents.description: Plan and execute editing jobs and report progress.

subtitle-translation.name: Subtitle translation
subtitle-translation.description: Translate timed subtitle cues to a selected language.

settings.label: Web search
settings.description: Lets the agent search the web while it works, for facts, prices and trends. It stays read-only and cannot run commands.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: The Claude model for this workspace's agent work, such as sonnet or opus. Leave empty to use Claude Code's default.

settings.label: Reasoning effort
settings.description: How long the agent thinks before answering. Higher effort gives better scripts and edits but takes longer.

settings.label: Use my installed plugins
settings.description: Lets the agent use the plugins and tool servers you installed for it yourself. They can see the workspace material the agent is given, so turn this on only for ones you trust.
